description: Selectable settings presets for modpacks (Fabric, client): first-launch chooser, Options > Presets..., merges only declared keys before mods load their configs.

mods.name: Preset Switcher
mods.description: Lets modpacks offer selectable settings presets (e.g. Potato / Default / Beautiful). Players pick one on first launch and can switch later from Options > Presets...; the preset's configs are merged in before other mods load them, keeping keybinds and personal settings.

releases.notes:
**NeoForge build for Minecraft 26.3** (client only).

*   Pack-defined settings presets: first-launch chooser, *Options > Presets...*, config screen from the mod list, restart notice; presets are merged in before other mods read their configs and only touch the declared keys (keybinds and personal settings are kept); pack updates keep the player's choice.
*   NeoForge build. The config button is in the mod list. The early hook is a library jar nested in the mod jar (jar-in-jar).
*   New in 1.1.0: one shared multi-version / multi-loader codebase (Stonecutter); keyboard control of the chooser (arrow keys, Enter); the graphicsPreset warning only on Minecraft 1.21.11+; data versions for new options.txt files on NeoForge/Forge.

Requires: NeoForge for Minecraft 26.3.

Tested (client: fresh install + chooser, preset after restart, keybinds/personal settings kept, pack update; dedicated server ignores it): NeoForge 26.3.0.95 on 26.3.
